edges.reason: msg.sender is returned verbatim by Context._msgSender().
_msgSender() supplies the sender argument to _transfer in transfer().
_msgSender() supplies the owner argument to _approve.
_msgSender() is used as the spender when reading and updating allowances in transferFrom.
msg.sender is checked against isMinter to skip the allowance decrease in PoolToken.burnFrom.
The onlyMinter modifier on mint validates msg.sender.
isMinter evaluates the caller identity obtained from _msgSender().
onlyMinter uses the isMinter result to gate ERC20Mintable.mint.
isMinter reads the _minters role mapping.
isReadyForDistribution compares the block timestamp `now` against nextDistributionTimestamp, making behaviour time dependent.
_createDistribution computes nextDistributionTimestamp from `now` with the aggregation period, a timestamp dependency.
nextDistributionTimestamp is the timestamp read for the readiness comparison.
A new Distribution record is pushed onto the distributions array.
distributions.length is read as the default toDistribution bound in _updateUserBalance.
nextDistributions[account] is read and updated inside _updateUserBalance.
distributionAccumulator is consumed and cleared when a distribution is created.
distribute performs distributionAccumulator = distributionAccumulator.add(amount) through SafeMath.
distribute calls _createDistributionIfReady which may invoke _createDistribution.
claimDistributions calls _createDistributionIfReady before crediting claims.
claimDistributions calls _updateUserBalance for each account.
_updateUserBalance writes the advanced index back to nextDistributions[account].
claimDistributions calls userBalanceChanged when a positive amount was claimed.
DistributionToken.userBalanceChanged is overridden by PoolToken.userBalanceChanged.
PoolToken.userBalanceChanged performs the external call to the reward distribution module.
The external rewardDistrModule call can re-enter PoolToken balance-change logic before state settles.
The external callback can re-enter claimDistributions and re-claim distributions.
PoolToken._transfer calls super._transfer (ERC20._transfer).
PoolToken._transfer notifies userBalanceChanged, leading to an external call before completion.
allowTransfers is read in PoolToken._transfer to gate user transfers.
setAllowTransfers writes the allowTransfers flag.
PoolToken.burnFrom minter path calls _burn directly, skipping the allowance deduction.
PoolToken.burnFrom non-minter path delegates to super.burnFrom.
ERC20Burnable.burnFrom calls the internal _burnFrom.
_burnFrom calls _burn to destroy tokens.
_burnFrom calls _approve to decrease the caller's allowance.
ERC20Mintable.mint calls the internal _mint.
_mint credits the recipient balance in _balances.
_mint increases _totalSupply using SafeMath add.
_burn debits the account balance in _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply using SafeMath sub.
_transfer updates _balances for sender and recipient.
_approve writes into the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom reads and reduces the _allowances entry for the caller.
transferFrom calls _transfer to move the tokens.
transferFrom calls _approve to update the remaining allowance.
_transferOwnership writes the new value into _owner.
PoolToken.initialize chains to Module.initialize which sets the pool address.
getModuleAddress performs a low-level staticcall to the pool contract.
The staticcall target is derived from the pool state variable.
The module name parameter controls the encoded signature of the get(string) call in getModuleAddress.
The initializer modifier sets the initialized flag.
The initializer modifier sets and later clears the initializing flag.
The initializer require condition calls isConstructor().
isConstructor executes the extcodesize assembly block.
The local isTopLevelCall determines whether initialization state is toggled.
The account parameter is forwarded to the external poolTokenBalanceChanged call.
The local rewardDistrModule is the target of the external call.
toDistribution bounds how many distributions are processed in claimDistributions.
fromDistribution is initialised from nextDistributions[account] inside _updateUserBalance.
The _pool parameter of PoolToken.initialize is passed to Module.initialize which assigns pool.
The newOwner parameter flows into _transferOwnership.
_updateUserBalance calls super._transfer to move claimed distribution tokens.
_createDistributionIfReady only calls _createDistribution when isReadyForDistribution is true.

normalization_plan.reason: The account parameter of PoolToken.userBalanceChanged has no independent semantics outside the function that forwards it to the notification hook.
The local rewardDistrModule reference exists only to be the target of the external poolTokenBalanceChanged call.
The module name parameter is only meaningful as the argument of the pool staticcall performed by getModuleAddress.
isTopLevelCall is an internal bookkeeping flag used only by the initializer modifier.
toDistribution is the bound parameter used exclusively by the claimDistributions overload.
fromDistribution is a transient copy of nextDistributions[account] used only inside _updateUserBalance.
The _pool parameter only serves to configure the pool reference during PoolToken.initialize.
The newOwner parameter only exists to be written into the _owner state variable by _transferOwnership.
